changes.title: Circle ring
items: Trees and bushes turning see-through in front of the witch no longer look milkier than the rest, so no ring shows round her in the forest
Switches to find the circle round the witch: ?occ=off, ?hole=off, ?hole=all and ?seedepth=off in the link; L's playtest log notes where she was and how it was seen when pressed

changes.title: Blend mix
items: Where two areas meet, their trees and bushes now mix one by one across the border instead of in clumps

changes.title: Map coasts
items: The map table on the treehouse deck shows the islands' real coastlines, and on the sea chart each island rises out of the sea as it's charted (no round stand-ins); the chart opens without the pauses the islands' arrival used to cause
